game_title: Pseudocode Bridge – Dust Devil Plain Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Dust Devil Plain, a plain of dust devils: the camel trader must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dust Devil Plain: a plain of dust devils
core_gameplay_loop: In Dust Devil Plain, repeat each round: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the bridge value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the water well using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The water well reached with actions_used <= 12.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the water well is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 4 (applied tier): Pseudocode Bridge
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pseudocode Bridge' (Week 9 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Dust Devil Plain'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dust Devil Plain.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The water well reached with actions_used <= 12.
